name: Cracking to internal wall or ceiling linings
description: Cracks in plaster or plasterboard walls, ceilings, cornices or bulkheads.

name: Cracking to external masonry
description: Cracks in brick or block walls, including stepped cracking through mortar joints.

name: Cracking to concrete paths, driveways or slab
description: Cracks in paving, driveways, garage or patio slabs.

name: Uneven or out-of-level floor
description: Floor visibly sloping, springy, or out of level across a room.

name: Door binding or not closing
description: Door jams, rubs on frame or floor, or will not latch.

name: Window binding or difficult to operate
description: Window sticks, will not open or close fully, or locks do not engage.

name: Water staining to ceiling
description: Stains or discolouration indicating a past or current roof or plumbing leak.

name: Dampness to walls
description: Damp patches, efflorescence or bubbling paint low on walls (possible rising damp).

name: Mould growth
description: Visible mould on ceilings, walls or joinery, often from poor ventilation.

name: Leaking shower or failed waterproofing
description: Water escaping the shower area: damaged skirting, swollen joinery or damp walls outside the shower.

name: Drummy, loose or cracked tiles
description: Tiles sound hollow when tapped, are cracked, or have lifted.

name: Deteriorated grout or silicone
description: Missing, cracked or mouldy grout or sealant at joints and junctions.

name: Inadequate fall to floor waste
description: Water ponds on the wet-area floor instead of draining to the waste.

name: Exhaust fan missing or not ducted outside
description: No exhaust fan, or fan discharges into the roof space.

name: Cracked, broken or slipped roof tiles
description: Roof tiles damaged or displaced, allowing water entry.

name: Deteriorated ridge pointing or bedding
description: Ridge or hip cap pointing cracked, missing or loose.

name: Corroded roof sheeting or flashings
description: Rust or corrosion on metal roofing, flashings or cappings.

name: Gutters blocked, overflowing or poorly graded
description: Debris in gutters, water lying in gutters, or signs of overflow onto fascias.

name: Gutters or downpipes corroded or leaking
description: Rust holes, leaking joints or damaged gutters and downpipes.

name: Downpipe not connected to stormwater
description: Downpipe discharges onto the ground next to the building.

name: Poor site drainage
description: Ground or paving falls toward the building, or water ponds against walls.

name: Ground level too high against wall
description: Soil, garden beds or paving built up against walls, covering weepholes or damp-proof course.

name: Weepholes blocked or missing
description: Weepholes above flashings covered, mortared up or not provided.

name: Inadequate subfloor ventilation
description: Too few or blocked subfloor vents; signs of damp under the floor.

name: Balustrade too low or with wide gaps
description: Barrier below required height, or gaps a 125 mm sphere could pass through.

name: Handrail missing or loose
description: Stair has no handrail, or handrail is loose or discontinuous.

name: Uneven stair risers or treads
description: Riser heights or tread depths vary noticeably within a flight.

name: Timber decay
description: Rot or decay to deck boards, posts, pergola members, fascias or window frames.

name: Deck or balcony structure loose or deteriorated
description: Loose, corroded or missing fixings; posts not bearing; structure moves under load.

name: Smoke alarm missing or not working
description: No smoke alarm near bedrooms, or alarm does not sound when tested.

name: Possible non-safety glass in wet area
description: Glazing in bathroom or shower without a visible safety-glass mark.

name: Hot water unit leaking or corroded
description: Water leaking from tank or fittings, or corrosion on the unit.

name: Relief valve drain not discharging safely
description: Relief or expansion valve drain missing, blocked or discharging against the building.

name: Ceiling insulation missing or displaced
description: Gaps in insulation or batts disturbed by trades.

name: Roof framing damaged or altered
description: Cut, cracked or sagging rafters, struts or purlins.

name: Evidence of roof leaks in roof space
description: Water stains on framing, sarking or top of ceiling linings.

name: Evidence of termite damage or workings
description: Mud leads, termite workings, or damaged or hollow-sounding timber.

name: Borer damage to timber
description: Exit holes or frass in flooring, framing or other seasoned timber.

name: Timber in contact with soil
description: Posts, sleepers, fences or framing touching the ground.

name: Slab edge covered
description: Paving, soil or garden beds covering the slab edge, hiding termite entry.

name: Garden beds or mulch against walls
description: Watered garden beds or mulch built up against the house.
